title: Prisma
label: Prisma
desc: Type-safe ORM for Node.js and TypeScript with a declarative schema, migrations and a generated client.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the Prisma 7 packages, scaffold the project and point the CLI at PostgreSQL.

snippets.code:
# Prisma 7 line: CLI, client, and the PostgreSQL driver adapter
npm install --save-dev prisma@7 typescript tsx @types/node
npm install @prisma/client@7 @prisma/adapter-pg pg dotenv

# Writes prisma/schema.prisma, prisma.config.ts and .env
npx prisma init --datasource-provider postgresql

# The CLI reads .env through prisma.config.ts
cat > .env <<'EOF'
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://app_user:devsecret@127.0.0.1:5432/warehouse?schema=public"
EOF

sections.title: Schema
sections.description: One file holds the generator, the datasource, enums and models the client is built from.

snippets.code:
# Parse the schema and report the first error with its line
npx prisma validate

# Rewrite the file in canonical form (spacing, alignment, ordering)
npx prisma format

# Build the typed client after any model change
npx prisma generate

sections.title: Datasource
sections.description: Pick a provider in the schema and keep the connection string in Prisma Config.

snippets.code:
# PostgreSQL, asking the server for TLS
export DATABASE_URL="postgresql://app_user:devsecret@db.internal:5432/warehouse?sslmode=require"

# MySQL
export DATABASE_URL="mysql://app_user:devsecret@db.internal:3306/warehouse"

# SQLite file, useful for tests and quick local work
export DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db"

sections.title: Models
sections.description: Map tables to types with keys, defaults, indexes and PostgreSQL native column types.

snippets.code:
model Product {
  id         Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  sku        String   @unique @db.VarChar(40)
  title      String   @db.VarChar(160)
  price      Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  stock      Int      @default(0)
  metadata   Json?
  thumbnail  Bytes?
  tags       String[]
  releasedOn DateTime @db.Date
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([title])
}

model WarehouseStock {
  warehouseId Int
  productId   Int
  quantity    Int @default(0)

  @@id([warehouseId, productId])
  @@map("warehouse_stock")
}

sections.title: Relations
sections.description: Connect models through relation fields and choose the action on delete.

sections.title: Migrations
sections.description: Version schema changes as SQL files and apply them in development, CI and production.

snippets.code:
# Diff the schema against the migrations and create a new SQL file
npx prisma migrate dev --name add_order_status

# Prisma 7 no longer generates during migrate; do it explicitly
npx prisma generate

# Prototype only: sync the database without writing migration files
npx prisma db push

# Apply every pending migration; safe to run from a deploy job
npx prisma migrate deploy

# Show which migrations are applied and which are still waiting
npx prisma migrate status

# Record a migration as applied when its SQL was executed by hand
npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 20260214120000_add_order_status

# Drop the development database and replay every migration
npx prisma migrate reset

# Seeding is explicit in Prisma 7, including after a reset
npx prisma db seed

sections.title: Raw SQL
sections.description: Send SQL directly while keeping parameters bound and results typed.

snippets.code:
type RevenueRow = { month: Date; revenue: bigint };

const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw<RevenueRow[]>`
  SELECT date_trunc('month', "placedAt") AS month,
         SUM("totalCents")::bigint      AS revenue
  FROM "Order"
  WHERE "status" = 'PAID'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY 1 DESC
`;

const changed = await prisma.$executeRaw`
  UPDATE "Product"
  SET "stock" = "stock" - 1
  WHERE "sku" = ${"KB-01"} AND "stock" > 0
`;

sections.title: Seeding
sections.description: Insert baseline rows with an idempotent script that runs on demand.

snippets.code:
# prisma.config.ts points migrations.seed at this command
npx prisma db seed

# Arguments after -- reach the seed script
npx prisma db seed -- --environment development

sections.title: Studio
sections.description: Browse and edit table data in a local web interface.

snippets.code:
# Local table browser on the default port 5555
npx prisma studio

# Use another port when 5555 is already taken
npx prisma studio --port 4466

# Load an explicit config file
npx prisma studio --config ./prisma.config.ts

sections.title: Common Errors
sections.description: Read the error code, then check the connection, constraint or missing row behind it.

snippets.code:
# Start with the schema and the migration ledger
npx prisma validate
npx prisma migrate status

# Check the connection without Prisma in the way
psql "postgresql://app_user:devsecret@127.0.0.1:5432/warehouse" -c "SELECT 1;"

# Regenerate after editing the schema; Prisma 7 does not do it implicitly
npx prisma generate

P1001  Cannot reach the database: wrong host or port, or the container is down
P1010  Access denied for the user: bad password or no CONNECT privilege
P2002  Unique constraint failed: a duplicate value for a unique field
P2003  Foreign key constraint failed: parent row missing or still referenced
P2025  Record required by update or delete was not found
